acquire_budget.$comment_max_download_bytes: 25 MiB soft cap for a small bounded extract of the pilot bbox + context buffer. A country-sized .osm.pbf download requires explicit human approval and must not be triggered automatically.
acquire_budget.$comment_max_disk_bytes_cache: 200 MiB soft cap for everything under data/cache/.
acquire_budget.$comment_require_human_approval_above_by: Any single acquisition estimated above 100 MiB must stop and ask a human before downloading, per project policy (no automatic country-sized downloads).
